description: Today's notable moves, already triaged by size: a $1T name gets its own row at 3%, anything gets one at 10%, and the rest bundle into a roundup per direction. For "what is moving right now?".

include_rsi.description: Append the two RSI(14) tail bundles (group 'rsi': RSI >= 75 / <= 25 over US listings >= $10B). Default false. Needs an Analyst-plan key or higher — the tails come from the RSI Watch screen.

name: get_price_alerts
